about: The self-cleanup registry: the one list of what counts as trash, who sweeps it, and when. sweep.js (browser), magi/sweep.py (MAGI engine) and tests/cleanup-rules.test.js all read this file. It covers A1-Priv too: its pages load sweep.js from A1's host, and an item's optional 'origin' ('a1' = anthonyn99.github.io, 'a1-priv' = a1-priv.av1.workers.dev) limits it to one of the two origins, which keep separate localStorage. An item deletes only when its 'delete' is true; false means dry run (listed in the sweep report, nothing removed). A new item ships false until Tony has seen its report. Add an item whenever a feature is removed. When in doubt, keep: an item needs an owner, a reason and a cap.
